comparison.objective: Place lumber stickers directly above supporting beams; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Long-part placement and support alignment versus small-tool insertion, rotary adjustment, locking, and diagnosis from repeated impacts.
comparison.success_condition: Stickers aligned over beams versus two energy-qualified stops without hard-stop contact or drift. PR has no detailed alignment tolerance.
comparison.reason: Structural placement alignment does not test damping adjustment or setting retention.
